**Fish** are creatures found in Appalachia, the Pitt, and Atlantic City in *Fallout 76*. Fishing was added as a gameplay mechanic with the *Gone Fission* update.

## Background[]

Fish survived the nuclear devastation of the Great War and are found throughout Appalachia. They are often found deceased, washed up on shores and on fish racks, collected for food. Scout Leader Jaggy mentions several species of pre-War fish, including bass, carp, bullhead catfish, musky, perch, and walleye. [1] [2] 

Many living fish can still be found in the waters of post-War Appalachia. Captain Raymond Clark and the Fisherman have set up a base at Fisherman's Rest where they ply their trade. The Vault 76 dwellers may join them in these fishing endeavors. Each of Appalachia's different regions have special fish found only in that area, while others are found all across Appalachia in all kinds of waters. Although not technically fish, instead being aquatic salamanders, axolotls are also commonly fished in Appalachia. [3] 

Living fish also appear in the Pitt, and can be found swimming in a shallow pool in the catacombs of the Sanctum. Other fish are also found in the Atlantic Ocean at Atlantic City.

## Characteristics[]

Fish are relatively the same size as before the war, with the addition of fleshy growths and sores on their sides. Delbert Winters mentions cooking with a variety of fish that he had never seen before while deployed, pretending they were catfish to make it more palatable. [4]

## Notes[]

The TV aquarium CAMP object contains three fish, one of which appears to be either a tadpole or a very small eel.

## Appearances[]

Fish appear in *Fallout 76*.
